user_instruction: Completion and notification rule (latest user instruction2026-10-29): A worthwhile academic finding triggers continued strategy development and testing, not a stop to announce the lead or ask whether to proceed. Complete evidence, permitted data acquisition, committed bounded preregistration/exact code and every earned design, historical-validation and current-portfolio comparison stage autonomously. Compare BASE/ADD/REPLACE/EMPTY at actual integer size for all eligible evaluation, funded and personal homes. Deliver completed backtest/account outcomes, reproducible code/input/ledger artifacts and material limits ready for the USER to send to Claude for verification; mark independent verification pending until actually done and send no external messages. Failed gates stop dependent tests; report a completed rejection without manufacturing later-stage comparisons or rescue variants. Record material source/data gaps and move on within existing limits. Checkpoint unfinished work for the next cycle when a cycle limit applies. Do not send standalone promising-paper/source-review/execution-reference alerts. Notify only for a new material completed test/portfolio result or a genuine user-action blocker; the existing once-only budget-cap notice remains. Brief nonblocking progress updates do not require a user decision. Preserve all existing source, preregistration, budget, cost, account and live-system boundaries.
